name: quartermaster
description: Looks back at your Claude Code sessions and turns the friction into setup fixes: plugins worth installing, rules worth writing, permissions worth allowing. A SessionEnd hook tallies each session locally (no LLM, no network); a retro skill mines the history and proposes changes one at a time, each needing your approval; the next retro reports whether what you applied actually reduced the friction it targeted. Also sets up new projects from what your history shows you keep needing.
